experiment: E36C pure-EEG raw-waveform adversarial nested evaluation

data.outer_results_status: previously inspected development results; any new outer run is confirmation-limited, not untouched validation

regularization_ablation.selection_data: all prescribed inner folds and full-Train fit only; never outer folds
regularization_ablation.selection_rule: eligible exact-full-Train-fit candidates passing all inner gates are ranked by inner fold-mean 100*C^0.40*U^0.25 at the inner clean-selected work point, then direct C, identity F1, AUROC, U@95, then larger shrinkage; if gates conflict, retain exact-fit candidates and use the same ranking while recording failed gates
regularization_ablation.clean_score_selection: for each shrinkage and outer-fold inner runs, jointly select max_cosine/margin/distance_ratio and threshold by 100*C^0.40*U^0.25 with clean known acceptance >=0.95; this is only regularization selection, not the final attack-aware threshold

subset.rule: for every fold, split, enrolled/unknown subject and task, sort by trial then path and take the first 8 eligible trials; no outcome-based sampling
subset.coverage: every fold, identity and task represented; actual counts are reported

attacks.signal_norm: L2 norm after subtracting each channel's temporal mean
attacks.pgd_step_size: 2*radius/steps with L2-normalized gradient and per-trial L2 projection
attacks.pgd_initialization: random direction with per-trial radius uniformly scaled in [0,1)
attacks.fgsm_step: one L2-normalized gradient step to the radius boundary
attacks.loss: cross_entropy(cosine_scores/0.05); maximize for untargeted and minimize for targeted
attacks.target_rule: next registered identity in the sorted enrolled-class cycle; never the true identity
attacks.differentiable_feature: the frozen five-band 1-40 Hz gpu_logspd -> detrend_zband chain; attack autocast/eigh uses float64
attacks.seed_rule: seed_base + 100000*stage_code + 10000*outer_fold + 1000*inner_fold + 100*attack_code + snr_db + batch_start; stage codes inner=1, outer=2, augmentation=3
attacks.isolation: inner attacks only against inner-fit models; outer attacks only against outer-fit models; augmentation attacks only against the corresponding fit-split model
attacks.gradient_checks: finite gradients/scores, per-trial radius relative error, realized SNR and N are recorded

threshold.grid: 101 evenly spaced quantiles from 0 to 0.05 of pooled inner clean-known confidence
threshold.objective: maximize macro Score=100*C^0.40*A^0.35*U^0.25 over all six attacks; ties by mean per-attack Score, macro RA, ASafeR, C, U, then configured score order
threshold.score_definitions: C from clean known; RA/ASafeR/A from each attacked known set; U from clean pseudo-unknown; AUROC/unknown F1 use attacked-known versus clean pseudo-unknown confidence; targeted attacks additionally report direct and accepted false-authentication rate
threshold.macro: arithmetic mean of six per-attack components, followed by Score computed from macro C/A/U; mean per-attack Score is also retained
threshold.q05: retain the pooled inner clean-known fifth-percentile threshold and report U@95
threshold.outer_rule: only apply each outer fold's inner-frozen score and threshold; no outer selection

targets.inner_clean_and_train: strict full-Train fit=1.0 and all preregistered inner clean gates
targets.robustness: macro RA>=0.95 and macro ASafeR>=0.98 without all rejection
targets.conflict_rule: report unmet gates and conflicts; never weaken attacks, remove difficult attacks, or use outer/Test for tuning

single_inner_improvement.trigger: baseline inner macro RA<0.95 or ASafeR<0.98 or any inner clean gate/full-Train requirement fails
single_inner_improvement.change: one fixed raw-PGD20/SNR20 plus raw-FGSM/SNR30 untargeted adversarial augmentation of the fit split; no other hyperparameter changes
single_inner_improvement.fit_rule: augment every fit subject/task with 8 stratified clean trials attacked against the clean-fit model, append both attacked feature sets to all clean fit features, and refit WCCN at the selected shrinkage
single_inner_improvement.selection_rule: compare baseline and augmentation only on prescribed inner folds; prefer a method satisfying exact full-Train fit and all inner clean gates, then higher inner macro Score, macro RA, macro ASafeR; if neither satisfies gates, use the same metric ranking and record the conflict
single_inner_improvement.limit: at most one augmentation variant; outer results cannot change this choice

reporting.test_metrics: N/A: Test was not read and has no labels
reporting.validation_boundary: nested pseudo-unknown, continuous file-block proxy and previously viewed outer development results; not untouched or cross-session confirmation
